description: This sweet and savory Korean Cream Cheese Garlic Bread is a viral sensation, featuring soft bread generously soaked in a rich garlic butter mixture and filled with a luscious, slightly sweet cream cheese filling. It is a delightful treat that perfectly balances savory garlic notes with creamy sweetness, making it an irresistible snack or dessert. Prepare to impress everyone with this unique and flavorful Korean baking masterpiece.

instructions.title: Prepare the Bread
instructions.text: Preheat your oven to 160°C (325°F). Take each bun and cut it into 6 or 8 wedges, making sure not to cut all the way through the bottom so the bun stays intact. This creates pockets for the filling and allows the garlic butter to seep in. Place the cut buns on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.

instructions.title: Make the Cream Cheese Filling
instructions.text: In a medium bowl, combine the softened cream cheese, granulated sugar, and heavy cream. Mix well with a whisk or spatula until the mixture is smooth and lump-free. If desired, you can add a tablespoon of honey or condensed milk for extra sweetness and richness. Transfer the cream cheese filling into a piping bag for easier handling.

instructions.title: Fill the Bread
instructions.text: Carefully open the wedges of each bun and pipe a generous amount of the cream cheese filling into each cut. Ensure the filling reaches deep into the bread pockets. You want a good amount of filling in each section for that signature creamy taste. Set the filled buns aside.

instructions.title: Prepare the Garlic Butter Dip
instructions.text: In another bowl, whisk together the melted unsalted butter, minced garlic, milk, and egg until thoroughly combined. This creates the savory garlic custardy dip that gives the bread its distinct flavor and moist texture. You can add a pinch of salt if your butter was unsalted.

instructions.title: Dip and Bake
instructions.text: Hold each filled bun and generously dip it into the garlic butter mixture, making sure to coat all sides and allow the liquid to seep into the cut wedges. You can also use a spoon to pour the mixture over the bread. Place the dipped buns back on the parchment-lined baking sheet. Bake in the preheated oven for 15-20 minutes, or until golden brown and fragrant.

instructions.title: Garnish and Serve
instructions.text: Once baked, remove the Korean Cream Cheese Garlic Bread from the oven. Let it cool slightly for a few minutes. Sprinkle generously with dried parsley flakes for color and a fresh aroma. Serve warm as a delightful snack, appetizer, or a unique dessert. Enjoy the perfect balance of sweet and savory!

tips: For the best texture, use fresh, soft dinner rolls or brioche buns. Stale bread will not absorb the garlic butter as well.
Ensure your cream cheese is at room temperature before mixing to achieve a smooth, lump-free filling. Cold cream cheese will be difficult to combine.
Do not overbake the bread, as it can become dry. Bake until just golden brown and the filling is bubbly, then remove promptly.
